name: krawings-timeclock
description: Capacitor wrapper (appId de.krawings.timeclock) around https://portal.krawings.de/kiosk — the 'Kiosk Attendance' time-clock app. KIOSK variant: ci/prepare-native.sh wires lock-task native code into the generated android/ project each build. Built by .github/workflows/build-timeclock.yml with this folder as its CWD; @capacitor/* resolve from the repo-root node_modules. The android/ project is generated per build and gitignored.
